This ticket is the survey rung and it waits its turn.

questions.a: FOUND BY RUNNING THE CHAIN, WHICH IS THE PREAMBLE EARNING ITS KEEP AT n=1. This defect had been standing since orient's floor started grounding refs and no reading of the code surfaced it. Stage 3 fired against a real request and returned an empty list where two rows belonged. That is the argument for the whole chain compressed into one observation, and it is recorded here because the chain is itself the thing under construction.

AN EMPTY LIST IS A LEGAL LIST, AND THAT IS THE MECHANISM OF SILENCE IN ALL THREE INSTANCES. constrain emitted an empty constraint list for 86% of its input; survey emits an empty census_rows; neither reddened anywhere. A floor that can contribute nothing without saying so is indistinguishable from a floor with nothing to contribute, and telling those apart is a separate and more general question than this ticket's line fix.

A STAGE THAT CHANGES WHAT IT EMITS CHANGES WHAT EVERY LATER FLOOR RECEIVES, AND NOTHING ANNOUNCES IT. Each stage's gate checks its own packet's shape, and the shape here was always legal — a list of strings, before and after. What changed was the KIND of string. This is the chain's real coupling and it is invisible to every door in it.

THE COST IS PAID BY decompose, NOT BY survey. `decompose_composes_holdings` refuses a compose piece whose address is not in the survey berth, so an under-filled holdings list narrows what the next stage is PERMITTED to build from. A floor that under-informs is a nuisance; a floor that under-informs a gate is a constraint nobody authored.

THE WATCH IS SCOPED TO SURVEY'S FLOOR AND DELIBERATELY NOT TO THE GENERAL DEFECT ABOVE IT. Re-firing skills/sorted/door.py on 2026-08-17 forced the question this hand cast never had to answer, and the answer is a refusal: 'an empty list is a legal list' was measured in two stages on one day (constrain 86%, survey 100%) and it is a property of every floor in the chain, so it has no single address and belongs as a spanning intention rather than under this node. Growing the watch to cover it would give this ticket a falsifier its one-line fix can never reach, and would let the line fix close over the defect it never touched. Recorded with its sibling finding: sorted_berth was null, so buildme_rides_the_sorted would have refused this ticket's first crossing whether or not the watch was ever specified — one hand cast, two gates it could not pass, and only one of them had an instrument watching.

watchme.trigger: every survey berth written by cairn.devices.builder.machines.survey.survey.write_survey — the door is the sole path to a survey packet, so the write IS the event and nothing polls
watchme.enough: when twenty survey berths have been written and every ref that address.component_of resolves to a component carried a census row — twenty because the defect stood for as long as it did by being INVISIBLE at n=1, and one green chain run is exactly the evidence that was available while it was broken. Stop early and loudly on the first berth where a resolvable component ref produced no row: an empty census_rows beside a component ref is the defect returning, and it is a finding rather than a sample

watchme.nexus: the survey tree — the question is about this stage's floor stratum, and the survey tree is what the dial measuring floor-vs-tree-vs-claude reads
watchme.consumer: skills/chart's survey stage, and the trouble lane, which holds the report this ticket answers
